description: v2.1.0 section 5.2 — a proposition that requires evaluation against a legal standard (Call 3 vocabulary). Distinct from GroundFactDef: this needs a legal_standard and authority_refs, and is typically grounded by one or more GroundFactDef instances rather than read off the case text directly.

canonical_meaning.description: Positive truth-condition sentence, e.g. 'robbery_level_threat(actor, victim)' -> '행위자가 반항을 억압할 정도의 폭행·협박을 가하였다.' Section 4.2 — canonical positive form, never a bar/waiver/absence-style negative predicate.

grounded_by.description: GroundFactDef ids whose Assessment feeds this element's evaluation. Optional — some elements are assessed directly from case text without a declared factual substrate. 2026-08-08 review: an earlier draft also allowed 'or other LegalElementDef' here, but no fixture ever exercised evaluative-on-evaluative grounding — retracted from the baseline rather than left as an untested standing allowance. If a real case later needs a LegalElementDef grounded by another LegalElementDef, that is a deliberate future addition (reopen this field), not something this baseline should silently permit.

legal_standard.description: The evaluative standard Call 3 applies, e.g. '사회통념상 반항을 억압할 정도의 폭행·협박인지 여부'. This is prose guidance for the neural assessor, not a symbolic rule — the symbolic layer only ever sees the resulting Assessment.evidence_state (runtime layer, out of scope for this schema).

semantic_exclusions.description: Authored boundary statements identifying adjacent concepts that must not be mistaken for this predicate. They refine meaning only and never provide case truth.

evidence_scope.description: Largest provenance-typed factual carrier for this predicate. Omission means `offense_realization`: the actions Call 1.5 selected for this legal realization (focal action plus its supports), which is what the planner has always supplied and what the measured runs were built on. A predicate that must be judged on one action alone has to say `exact_actor_action` explicitly. `same_actor_episode` widens to every action of the episode the responsibility actor takes part in and never admits a peer actor's conduct. An explicit scope outranks the generic actor-bound GroundFact narrowing. It never authorizes full-case evidence, and participation targets are outside this contract: they carry a typed relation carrier of their own.

temporal_anchor.description: When present, the element is evaluated only at the realization's focal factual action rather than from later supporting actions or the broader episode.

semantic_sort.description: 2026-08-08 Step 5 addendum — same meaning as GroundFactDef.semantic_sort: this atomic predicate's intrinsic semantic sort, used by Step 5 relation lowering when a PrimitiveDef wrapping this element (or this element itself) lands on a relation endpoint. Optional for the same reason.
